opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income households, not eligible for other tuition fee support, ordinarily resident in Scotland (or substantial connection), eligible for UK indefinite leave or asylum seeker, enrolled in an undergraduate degree at a Scottish HE institution, meeting specific course and residency criteria.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,820 per year to cover tuition fees for eligible undergraduate students from low‑income households who cannot obtain government tuition fee support.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants

amount.raw: capped at a maximum of £5,000 per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income Scottish households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, enrolled in a full‑time or part‑time taught or research master’s programme at a Scottish university for the 2026/27 academic year.
opportunities.summary: Supports graduates from low‑income households to undertake postgraduate master’s study by providing up to £5,000 per year.
